Class ResearcherEmployee

java.lang.Object
com.uni.models.User
com.uni.models.Employee
com.uni.models.ResearcherEmployee
All Implemented Interfaces:
Researcher, Serializable
public class ResearcherEmployee extends Employee implements Researcher
An employee whose only role is research (not Teacher, not Manager, not Admin). Always a Researcher.
